name: macro-loop
description: A regular routine for AI-assisted development on GitHub Issues: triage, grill, spec, implement, open a PR, and verify in a fresh context. Each stage can be the entry point; a missing input warns instead of blocking, and a skipped stage is recorded on the Issue as a skipped:* label so it can be counted later. Works in local and cloud Claude Code sessions through the GitHub REST API. Skills are forked from mattpocock/skills (MIT).
